{{Top|leg}}
'''Jahhnu''' was one of the three major [[City/Legends|cities]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Farrfin]]. The city was a haven for [[Scoundrel/Legends|criminals]] in addition to housing several [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] locations that earned a great deal of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] from gullible offworlders.
